set.body:
Outcome

Create the authoritative migration ledger.

Acceptance

- Maps every production source, test, example, fixture, public type, and downstream consumer in mvpa, mvpa-fit, mvpa-dataset, and mvpa-spatial.
- Classifies each item as retain kernel, rewrite, replace, or delete.
- Records independent oracle provenance and estimand identity.
- Identifies all current public vocabulary that must disappear.
set.title: P0.2: inventory retained kernels, consumers, fixtures, and deletion targets
